title_en: A Weekend Junk Project Now Makes $140K/Month
title_jp: 週末に作ったガラクタが今は月収14万ドル

{"ops": [{"insert": "一个周末做的破烂玩意儿，现在月入14万"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "德国程序员：我本想随便试试，没想到玩大了", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你见过最草率的创业是什么样的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lukas Hermann告诉你：周末两天，一个破计时器，上线的时候连收费功能都没有。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "月入2万美元。约合人民币14万。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "故事开始于一次串门。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lukas去朋友的工作室玩。朋友是个视频制作人，正在忙活一场直播。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "突然，朋友从椅子上弹起来，冲向另一个房间。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "去干嘛？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "开计时器。一个装在老旧笔记本上的桌面软件，界面丑得像Windows 98。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lukas懵了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""都2021年了，还用这玩意儿？""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他搜了一圈，发现市场上真的没什么像样的替代品。要么太复杂，要么太古老。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "作为前端工程师，Lukas脑子里闪过一句话："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""这玩意儿，我一个周末就能做出来。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他真的做了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "周六早上开始，周日晚上上线。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "技术栈？Vue.js + Node.js + MongoDB。全是他会的东西。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "产品有多简单？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你在这台设备点"开始"，那台设备的计时器就开始倒数。就这一个功能。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "没用户系统。没支付功能。没花里胡哨的界面。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lukas说他是故意的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""我就想验证一件事：这东西有人用吗？""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他把它免费发布到Reddit的一个专业论坛。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "本来没抱希望。结果评论区炸了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""终于有人做出来了！""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""这正是我需要的！""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""能不能加个XX功能？""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "需求列表像雪片一样飞来。Lukas看傻了，也乐坏了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "产品有了，怎么赚钱？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lukas一开始没想这事。直到有用户主动问："能不能付费去广告？""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他这才如梦初醒。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原来，免费版本会在计时器上显示品牌Logo。每次活动、每场直播、每个会议，成千上万人都能看见。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这是天然的广告牌啊。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lukas推出了付费版。功能更强，Logo消失。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但问题随之而来——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用户流失率高得吓人。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "月流失率12%。意味着一年后，几乎没人留下来。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "为啥？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为用户只为特定活动付费。活动结束，立刻取消订阅。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lukas挠破了头，想出一个骚操作。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他推出了"活动许可证"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一次性购买，30天有效，自动到期不续费。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "价格？几乎是月订阅的两倍。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你猜怎么着？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用户爱死这个方案了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""终于不用记取消订阅了！""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""可以直接开票给客户，太方便了！""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "月流失率从12%降到3%。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lukas悟出一个道理："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "别跟用户对着干，顺着他们的使用习惯来。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在，Stagetimer服务着从个人活动组织者到微软、宜家这样的大客户。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "50%用户来自Google搜索，30%来自口碑推荐。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lukas已经全职投入这个项目。之前他在一家创业公司当前端，项目被砍后，公司多给了一个月工资让他找工作。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他老婆说："别找工作了，全职干Stagetimer吧。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那时产品月入3000美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他听了老婆的话。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lukas给新手创业者的建议是什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""选你列表里最简单的那个想法。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是最性感的，不是最创新的，是最简单的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""第一个产品教会你的，比它赚到的钱更重要。让学习过程尽可能容易。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他还特别叮嘱德国读者："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""别被 bureaucracy（官僚主义）吓住。隐私政策、税务、法律条款确实麻烦，但一旦滚起来，就没那么可怕了。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你看，创业这事儿，有时候真不需要宏大叙事。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一个周末，一个破计时器，解决一个小问题。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后，让市场告诉你接下来怎么走。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "就像Lukas说的——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "找到正确的Reddit社区，比写代码花的时间还长。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这才是真相。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: A weekend made trash thing now earning one hundred forty thousand monthly. German programmer told me I wanted to try casually did not expect it to get huge. Have you seen the most casual startup. Lukas Hermann tells you two days weekend a broken timer even no charging function when launched. Now. Twenty thousand dollars monthly. About one hundred forty thousand RMB. One. Story started from a visit. Lukas went to friend studio to play. Friend is video producer busy with a live stream. Suddenly friend jumped from chair rushed to another room. To do what. Open timer. A desktop software installed on old laptop with ugly interface like Windows ninety eight. Lukas was confused. It is twenty twenty one still using this thing. He searched一圈 found market really no decent alternatives. Either too complex or too old. As front end engineer Lukas had thought in mind. This thing I can make in one weekend. Two. He really did. Saturday morning started Sunday night launched. Tech stack Vue.js plus Node.js plus MongoDB. All he knows. How simple product. You click start on this device timer counts down on that device. Just this one function. No user system. No payment function. No fancy interface. Lukas says he.
